description.value: Petrichor is a French farmhouse-style restaurant in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, founded by Luc-André Duval, who hails from Montpellier in southern France and brings his background in high-end French and international hospitality to the menu. The kitchen focuses on elevated French classics — escargots, duck breast, boeuf bourguignon — made in-house with locally sourced ingredients wherever possible. The space is designed to evoke a southern French farmhouse and emphasises social dining, with cocktails, local beers, and wines alongside the food.
